penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Meaningful productivity analytics requires integrating with each customer's specific toolchain (GitHub, Jira, Copilot telemetry, IDE plugins). Initial setup and calibration is inherently per-customer manual work.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Engineering managers will have specific questions about metric interpretation, benchmarks, and anomalies — requiring ongoing human-judgement support.

rationale: The buyer is real and identifiable (CTOs / EM at 10-500 engineer companies) and they do spend on engineering tooling, but building a credible AI productivity analytics layer requires deep integrations with each customer's stack — IDE plugins, VCS telemetry, CI pipelines — that are far beyond Claude + a form + Stripe. Operational autonomy is low because onboarding every team will require custom configuration. Total drops to 3.0 after penalties, well below the validate threshold.
solution_plan: Not viable for a solo non-technical operator with this factory. A trustworthy productivity-measurement layer requires telemetry agents deployed inside customers' development environments, per-customer calibration sessions, and ongoing metric-interpretation support. None of these steps can run autonomously via Claude + a static form. A funded devtools startup with engineering capacity is the right vehicle for this opportunity — not this factory.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy_min (4 < 7) and buildability_with_ai_min (4 < 6) build gates. Dropped on total score alone (3.0 < 5.5).
